graduation_surfaces: websearch: Getmomo Finanzierungsrunde 2024 2025 Series A -> only vendor profiles; latest round remains June 2022
notes: The EUR 3.5M round was reported in June 2022 and made official on 2023-03-02 together with a Vereinigte Volksbank Raiffeisenbank underwriting partnership: deutsche-startups ('Element Ventures, Atlantic Labs, Visionaries Club und Global Founders Capital (GFC) investieren – wie bereits im Juni 2022 berichtet – 3,5 Millionen Euro'), FinanceFWD, 13books (formerly Element Ventures) post. No source names the round or a lead; Tracxn (vendor) calls it 'Seed VC - II', which hints at an earlier seed tranche that no press names, so an earlier Visionaries check cannot be excluded. Founded 2021 by Marcel Meitza (13books: 'Launched in 2021'); GetMomo Financial GmbH, Oranienstraße 6, Berlin, HRB 211213 B (imprint). If the judge reads the round as Seed, graduation is not_graduated (no later round found).
